newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZCCM November copper, cobalt production up.
newsitem.headline: ZCCM November copper, cobalt production up.

text.p: Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines' (ZCCM) copper production lifted in November to 22,052 tonnes from October's low of 18,338 tonnes, central bank statistics showed on Tuesday.
The figures however showed that copper exports dropped in November to a year low of 16,562 tonnes from 30,889 tonnes the previous month.
ZCCM's copper production plunged to a two-year low in October due to production problems at its Nkana smelter.
Bank statistics also showed an increase in ZCCM's November cobalt production to 443 tonnes from 243 tonnes in October with exports reaching a year high at 626 tonnes.
